newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sea-Com says to withdraw from Tokyo bourse.
newsitem.headline: Sea-Com says to withdraw from Tokyo bourse.

text.p: Japan's Sea-Com Corp said on Thursday that it will withdraw its shares from the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) after failing to win support for a new restructuring plan from its main creditor.

"We had tried to avoid delisting....but we have failed to obtain support from our main creditor the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (for the restructuring plan) so we gave up our effort to keep listed (on the bourse)," the company said in a statement. It stopped short of saying when the company will be delisted from the TSE's second section.
Sea-Com, which operates shipping and hotel businesses, said its debt would exceed assets by 46 billion yen at the end of March.
It said its financing division and overseas division had been hit hard by the bursting of Japan's economic "bubble" of inflated asset prices in the late 1980s.
